description: OCR / image to text / text extraction from screenshots, receipts, invoices, scanned documents, signs and photos (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF up to 3 MB). Returns text in reading order, or Markdown with tables and lists. $0.002 USDC per image on Base via x402; images without text are not charged. Price: $0.002 per image. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (max 3 MB). Preferred.

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key: same payer + requestKey + input returns the stored result without a second charge (7 days).

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.

name: image_to_text_ocr
title: OCR: image to text
